spec2def(acledit.dll acledit.spec)

# acledit.dll is all Rust (acledit-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/acledit-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# acledit.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/acledit-rust/src/acledit/acledit.rs)
# stubs.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/acledit-rust/src/acledit/stubs.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(acledit_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(acledit_shims PRIVATE libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(acledit_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(acledit acledit-cargo acledit.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE acledit-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS acledit_shims psdk)
